_doc: Constants of rao1961_posing.py [X-RAOPO] (S37 2026-09-24): Rao 1961's Table 1 contour from HIS optimality conditions by OUR inverse march, and the TR-SQP re-obtention from a start cut through that field. Every number is a posing choice, a world constant identified elsewhere, or a value Rao prints; none was fitted here. Rao's inputs (gamma 1.23, M_E 2.4, theta_E -8.25 deg, p_a/p_c 0.0355), his Table 1 and his published terminus are imported from rao1961_world / rao1961_control_surface, the literals of record.

world.note: the gas of the Rao-world twin [X-RAOTW], identified from GENO's field (Rg, p0, T0): units only -- every graded number is dimensionless (x/R_E, r/R_E, eps, C_F); R_E = 1 m

inverse.note: the inverse (Goursat) march of [X-AFAN] with HIS control surface as the terminal C-: rays from E at the corner relation theta(M) = theta_E - (nu(M_E) - nu(M)), uniform in the planar ray angle from the leading ray at M_i (the sonic line cannot be a ray: C+ and C- coincide at M 1; 1.05 as [X-AFAN]'s sonic-lip test) to ED itself; ED = his first integrals Eqs. (6)-(7), x from his Eq. (5), cut at his published terminus R_D/R_E 0.137 (rao1961_our_functional.build_surface, ed_points samples), resampled at uniform arc length (lev_power 1); the ladder (rays, levels) x 0.25/0.5/1 as [X-AFAN]; M_grid tabulates the corner relation

bands.note: Rao's printing: eps and C_F to 3 significant figures (5e-3 relative, as [X-RAOFN]); Table 1 coordinates to 3 decimals (half a unit 5e-4 R_E)

walk.note: the [X-RAOSQ] v3 posing verbatim (x0 0.30 R_E, 61 rows, 81 stations, 8 knots with the tip pinned at his D, the near-cut 35 percent frozen to his contour, 1.5 percent alternating perturbation, 12 segments, rejector budget 14, trust radius 0.05) with ONE change: the start line is the cut at x0 through OUR inverse field instead of GENO's

controls.note: the rejector's neighbouring optimum: his construction with theta_E moved by a quarter degree (his theta prints to 0.01 deg; a quarter degree is a different design by any reading)
